name: Dataset Schema Validation
summary: Validate that a dataset's actual schema matches its declared specification including field names, types, and required fields
purpose: Validate that a dataset's actual schema matches its declared specification including field names, types, and required fields.
assignment_instructions: You are evaluating a dataset's schema compliance. REQUIRED OUTPUT: Return a JSON object with these exact fields: - assignment_id (string): use "dataset_schema_validation_v1" - agent_summary (string): summary of findings - inputs_used (list of strings): inputs you used - missing_inputs (list of strings): any missing inputs - claims (list of objects): each with claim (string), evidence_reference (string), confidence (one of: "provided", "inferred", "missing") - calculations (list of objects): each with name, formula, inputs (object), result (number or null), units (string), assumptions (list of strings) - risks (list of objects): each with risk (string), severity ("low"|"medium"|"high"), evidence_reference (string) - assumptions (list of strings) - open_questions (list of strings) - final_output (string): your conclusion - self_check (object): all_required_sections_completed (boolean), all_numbers_have_sources (boolean), assumptions_labeled (boolean), missing_inputs_disclosed (boolean) Also include these schema-specific fields: - schema_compliance_rate (number between 0 and 1) - field_checks (list of objects): each with field_name (string), declared_type (string), actual_type (string), compliant (boolean) - missing_required_fields (list of strings) - extra_fields_detected (list of strings) Compute schema_compliance_rate as: compliant_field_count / total_required_fields. Return as a number. If data is missing, set missing_inputs and flag the issue. Use only the provided evidence unless explicitly allowed to assume; label every assumption; if a required input is missing, say so; do not fabricate facts or cite evidence that was not provided.

deterministic_checks.description: schema_compliance_rate must be a float between 0.0 and 1.0 inclusive
Every field in declared_schema must appear in field_checks
Any non-compliant required field must be in missing_required_fields
deterministic_checks.assertion: all(not f.compliant for f in result.field_checks if f.field_name in required_fields) implies f.field_name in result.missing_required_fields

math_checks.description: Fraction of required fields that match declared type

evidence_checks.description: Each field check must reference a specific field from the declared schema
Must report actual detected type, not just boolean

flag_rules.description: One or more required fields are missing or non-compliant
